author: pelican state news
title: New Orleans Police seek suspect in aggravated battery by cutting case
text:
The New Orleans Police Department is seeking the public’s assistance in locating Kendrich D. Mackie, who is wanted for aggravated battery by cutting, according to a June 17 announcement.
Police identified Mackie, a Black male with a date of birth of May 8, 1986, as the suspect in an incident that occurred around 12:30 a.m. on June 7 in the 4300 block of Werner Drive. Investigators said Mackie was identified as the perpetrator through their investigation and confirmed that a warrant for his arrest is on file.
Authorities emphasized that all persons are presumed innocent until proven guilty.
Anyone with information that could assist in this investigation is encouraged to contact Seventh District detectives at 504-658-6070. Anonymous tips can be provided to Crimestoppers of Greater New Orleans at 504-822-1111 or toll-free at 1-877-903-STOP. Tips may also be submitted online at https://www.crimestoppersgno.org .
Questions or corrections regarding this case can be directed to the New Orleans Police Department’s Public Affairs Division via email at nopdpio@nola.gov.
